items.statement: Enrolment in case management before the index date is associated with lower odds of death or ICU admission within 12 months (odds ratio 0.6 or lower) after matching on age, sex and calendar time and adjustment for prior visits and comorbidity.
items.rationale: Decides the program's future on outcomes that matter; the single-site estimate (claim c1) sets the planning value.
items.risks: Residual confounding; too few cases at one site.

items.statement: The association is stronger with longer time since enrolment.
items.rationale: A dose-response pattern would support a real effect.

items.statement: The association differs between tertiary and community sites.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 selected as the primary association.
